verses.en: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.pt: SENHOR, em tua força o rei se alegra; e como ele fica contente com tua salvação!
verses.en_web: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> The king will be glad in your strength, O Lord; how great will be his delight in your salvation!

verses.en: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.pt: Tu lhe deste o desejo de seu coração; e tu não negaste o pedido de seus lábios. (Selá)
verses.en_web: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not kept back the request of his lips. (Selah.)

verses.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.pt: Porque tu foste até ele com bênçãos de bens; tu puseste na cabeça dele uma coroa de ouro fino.
verses.en_web: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
verses.en_bbe: For you go before him with the blessings of good things: you put a crown of fair gold on his head.

verses.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Ele te pediu vida, e tu lhe deste; muitos dias, para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: He asked life of you, you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: He made request to you for life, and you gave it to him, long life for ever and ever.

verses.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.pt: Grande é a honra dele por tua salvação; honra e majestade tu lhe concedeste.
verses.en_web: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
verses.en_bbe: His glory is great in your salvation: honour and authority have you put on him.

verses.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.pt: Porque tu o pões em bênçãos para sempre; tu fazes abundante a alegria dele com tua face.
verses.en_web: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
verses.en_bbe: For you have made him a blessing for ever: you have given him joy in the light of your face.

verses.en: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.pt: Porque o rei confia no SENHOR; e ele nunca se abalará com a bondade do Altíssimo.
verses.en_web: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
verses.en_bbe: For the king has faith in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Most High he will not be moved.

verses.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.pt: Tua mão alcançará a todos o os teus inimigos; tua mão direita encontrará aos que te odeiam.
verses.en_web: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
verses.en_bbe: Your hand will make a search for all your haters; your right hand will be hard on all those who are against you.

verses.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.pt: Tu os porás como que num forno de fogo no tempo em que se encontrarem em tua presença; o SENHOR em sua ira os devorará; e fogo os consumirá.
verses.en_web: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
verses.en_bbe: You will make them like a flaming oven before you; the Lord in his wrath will put an end to them, and they will be burned up in the fire.

verses.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.pt: Tu destruirás o fruto deles de sobre a terra; e também a semente deles dos filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
verses.en_bbe: Their fruit will be cut off from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.pt: Porque eles quiseram o mal contra ti; planejaram uma cilada, mas não tiveram sucesso.
verses.en_web: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
verses.en_bbe: For their thoughts were bitter against you: they had an evil design in their minds, which they were not able to put into effect.

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.pt: Porque tu os porás em fuga; com tuas flechas nas cordas tu lhes apontarás no rosto.
verses.en_web: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
verses.en_bbe: Their backs will be turned when you make ready the cords of your bow against their faces.

verses.en: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.pt: Exalta-te, SENHOR, em tua força; cantaremos e louvaremos o teu poder. Salmo de Davi para o regente, como em “cerva da manhã”:
verses.en_web: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
verses.en_bbe: Be lifted up, O Lord, in your strength; so will we make songs in praise of your power.
